_note: Config for agent_voice_lint.py. Copy into a project and edit; the script merges its built-in lists rather than replacing them, so this file only ever adds.
repeat_allowlist: what to do rather than what to avoid
the counterweight in the base voice

reply.note: a question gets an answer; past ~15 lines it is a report

report.note: outcome, what changed, what is open

commit.note: imperative subject under 72 chars, no full stop

review.note: one issue per comment, each with its failure scenario

doc.note: every section load-bearing for a decision

skill.note: push depth to references; the runner pays for this on every call

brief.note: no brevity rule; an underspecified brief is the expensive failure
